get.description:
Return the current answer bank.

Args:
    request: Incoming request carrying the app state.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.

Returns:
    The answer bank state.

Raises:
    ApiError: If the answer bank cannot be read.

post.description:
Apply one change to the answer bank from the local dashboard.

Args:
    body: The change and the revision it expects.
    request: Incoming request; it needs exactly one loopback origin and host.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.

Returns:
    The answer bank state after the change.

Raises:
    ApiError: If the request is not from the local dashboard or the change
        is rejected.

get.description:
Return the preparation queue status.

Args:
    request: Incoming dashboard request.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.
    request_id: Limit the status to this request, if given.

Returns:
    Queue requests, consumer status and the CSRF token.

Raises:
    ApiError: If the queue status is unavailable.

post.description:
Queue canonical real jobs for preparation.

Args:
    body: Request ID and the real job IDs to queue.
    request: Incoming dashboard mutation request.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.

Returns:
    The receipt for the queue request.

Raises:
    ApiError: If the queue rejects the request.

get.description:
Return the status of one handoff request.

Args:
    request: Incoming dashboard request.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.
    request_id: ID of the handoff request.

Returns:
    The handoff's receipt, if the request exists.

Raises:
    ApiError: If the request is not a handoff or the queue is unavailable.

post.description:
Hand selected jobs to an Applier runtime from the local dashboard.

Args:
    body: Request ID, job selection, runtime and explicit authorization.
    request: Incoming dashboard mutation request.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.

Returns:
    The receipt for the handoff request.

Raises:
    ApiError: If the request does not come from the loopback dashboard or
        the queue rejects it.

get.description:
Return whether a job can be rerun, and its latest rerun request.

A job is not eligible while the extension cannot probe Chrome profiles.

Args:
    request: Incoming dashboard request.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.
    batch_id: Batch the job belongs to.
    job_id: Job to check.

Returns:
    The rerun state.

Raises:
    ApiError: If the rerun state is unavailable.

post.description:
Request a rerun of one job's application from the local dashboard.

Args:
    body: The rerun request.
    request: Incoming dashboard mutation request.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.

Returns:
    The rerun state after the request.

Raises:
    ApplicationRerunError: Internally, when the extension cannot probe
        profiles or the server is not on a loopback address.
    ApiError: If the rerun cannot be requested.

Pass the user's confirmation of a reviewed preview to the pipeline.

Args:
    body: Request ID, the reviewed preview and the confirmation.
    request: Incoming dashboard mutation request.
    response: Response whose headers are set.

Returns:
    The pipeline's response to the confirmation.

get.description:
Return the tab bindings, CSRF token and profile probe availability.

Args:
    request: Incoming dashboard request.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.

Returns:
    The current application tab state.

post.description:
Redeem a pairing code from the extension and issue tab credentials.

Args:
    body: Pairing code, selected tab and browser session.
    request: Incoming request from the extension.
    response: Response whose CORS and cache headers are set.

Returns:
    The binding ID and session token for the tab.

Raises:
    ApiError: If the origin is not the extension or the pairing is rejected.

Ask the extension which candidate tabs are in its Chrome profile.

Args:
    body: Candidate tabs to look for.
    request: Incoming dashboard request with a CSRF token.

Returns:
    A short-lived proof of the matching tabs.

Raises:
    ApiError: If the extension is unavailable or the probe fails.

Check that a profile proof is still valid for the current extension connection.

Args:
    body: The profile proof to check.
    request: Incoming dashboard request with a CSRF token.

Returns:
    The proof's validity and expiry.

Raises:

Bind a proven, recorded tab to a job through the extension.

Args:

    request: Incoming dashboard request with a CSRF token.

Args:

Focus a job's registered tab, reconnecting it when needed.

Args:

    body: Owner thread the tab was recorded for.
    request: Incoming dashboard request with a CSRF token.

Issue a pairing code for a job's recorded tab.

    request: Incoming dashboard request with a CSRF token.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.

Returns:

    ApiError: If the job has no recorded tab or pairing capacity is full.

get.description:
List recent application records, newest first.

    response: Response whose cache headers are set.

Returns:

Return the trace of a job's newest Applier run.

Args:

    request: Incoming request carrying the app state.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.
    store: Store used to label the run with its job.

    The run's trace tree.

Return saved application observations without running a diagnostic.

Args:
    request: Request bound to the configured dashboard dependency graph.

Returns:
    Allowlisted queue and monitor observations from the configured runtime.

Return a summary of a job's submission confirmation evidence.

Args:
    job_id: Job whose confirmation should be read.
    request: Incoming request carrying the app state.

Returns:
    The evidence summary, or an unverified status.

Return the screenshot saved as a job's submission confirmation.

Args:
    job_id: Job whose confirmation should be read.
    request: Incoming request carrying the app state.

Returns:
    The screenshot image as an uncached response.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if the evidence is unavailable or is not a website
        screenshot.

Return the saved form observations for one job in a batch.

Args:
    job_id: Job whose form should be read.
    batch_id: Batch the application run belongs to.
    request: Incoming request carrying the app state.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.

Return the résumé PDF attached to one saved form snapshot.

Args:
    job_id: Job whose form should be read.
    batch_id: Batch the application run belongs to.
    snapshot_id: Snapshot whose résumé should be returned.
    request: Incoming request carrying the app state.

Returns:

    HTTPException: 404 if the résumé cannot be read.

Observe the latest diagnostic without dispatching one.

Args:
    request: Current dashboard request.

Returns:
    Safe status plus the per-server mutation token.

post.description:
Admit one manual, same-origin, bounded diagnostic request.

Args:
    request: Dashboard request with token and a strict JSON UUID body.

Returns:
    The newly admitted or original active diagnostic.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the origin, token, body or local setup is invalid.

get.description:
Serve a synthetic file chooser with no upload or submission action.

Args:
    request: Dashboard request.
    run_id: Admitted diagnostic UUID.

Returns:
    Static fixture with restrictive content policy.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the fixture is unknown.

Six-bucket attention report — the digest footer's data over the wire.

Args:
    workflow: Shared workflow service from the app state.
    store: Shared job store (pipeline-health read).

Returns:
    Three workflow buckets plus three pipeline-health buckets, both
    with store-default thresholds.

List tracked companies, slug-ascending.

Args:
    store: Shared job store from the app state.
    vendor: Optional ATS vendor filter.
    include_removed: Whether soft-removed rows are included.

Returns:
    Company rows with vendor, failure count, and the derived removed flag.

post.description:
Track a company with a pinned vendor (upsert; never re-probed).

The upsert's ON CONFLICT path also restores a soft-removed slug: the new
vendor overwrites the removal sentinel.

Args:
    body: Slug and pinned ATS vendor.
    store: Shared job store from the app state.

Returns:
    The written row (vendor pinned, failure counter reset to zero).

Upsert many companies at once, skipping slugs that are already active.

Payload duplicates collapse to their first occurrence. Slugs tracked and
not removed are skipped; everything else — new or soft-removed — goes
through the same upsert path as the single POST, so a removed company in
the payload is restored. Bulk rows write ``ats_override=False``
(mirroring ``bootstrap-companies``) so bulk-added vendors stay
re-probeable.

Args:
    body: Bulk rows (slug + vendor each).
    store: Shared job store from the app state.

Returns:
    Count of rows upserted (new plus restored).

Resolve each pasted entry's ATS vendor without writing anything.

Entries are normalized to candidate slugs (lowercase trim; vendor board
URLs reduce to their slug), then probed under a per-request concurrency
bound of 5. One entry's failure never aborts the batch.

Args:
    body: Pasted entries (1..200).
    probe: Injected per-slug vendor probe from the cli assembly.

Returns:
    Per-entry results in request order.

delete.description:
Stop tracking a company (soft remove via the vendor sentinel).

The path slug is normalized (trim + lowercase) before the store call,
matching the write endpoints' slug handling.

Args:
    slug: Company board slug.
    store: Shared job store from the app state.

Returns:
    Acknowledgement.

Raises:
    ApiError: 422 for text outside the slug charset; 404 when the slug
        is unknown or already removed.

get.description:
Return effective editable settings and onboarding state.

Args:
    editor: Project-local configuration editor.

Returns:
    Effective user-editable settings without database or secret values.

put.description:
Atomically save valid settings and apply them to new work.

Args:

Returns:

get.description:
Report process liveness and database reachability.

Args:
    store: Shared job store from the app state.

Returns:

    succeeds, else 503 with a degraded body.

Aggregate insights: totals, distributions, and daily series.

The requested window selects the discovery-date cohort for totals,
distributions, and the daily series.

Args:
    service: Shared insights service from the app state.
    window: Window in days (1..365), or ``all`` for no lower cutoff.

Returns:

Return known source IDs in request order; absent sources are omitted.

Args:
    job_ids: Comma-separated positive source job IDs, at most 100.
    response: Response whose cache headers are set.
    store: Store that holds the stars.

Returns:
    Stars for the known source jobs, without duplicates.

Raises:
    ApiError: If there are too many IDs or one is not a positive integer.

List jobs for one tab with optional filters, fold, sort, pagination.

``tab_counts`` apply ALL request filters (statuses, search, freshness,
require_verdict), so sidebar/global counts should come from requests
WITHOUT ``statuses``/``require_verdict`` narrowing.

Args:
    params: Validated query parameters (plan A4 contract).
    service: Shared jobs view service from the app state.

Returns:
    Jobs page: ``jobs`` (the view rows), true ``total``, ``tab_counts``.

post.description:
Transition multiple jobs with twin-cluster cascade.

Args:
    body: Requested (id, to) pairs and the force flag.
    service: Shared workflow service from the app state.

Returns:
    Outcome summary: succeeded, skipped, failed items, cascaded count.

Raises:
    ApiError: 422 when a job id is not numeric.

get.description:
Aggregate the full detail view for one job.

Args:
    job_id: Store-assigned job identity (numeric).
    service: Shared jobs view service from the app state.

Returns:
    Job, evaluation blocks, status + history + notes, twins, interview

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 (shared error shape) when the job is unknown.

post.description:
Refuse unverified new submissions while preserving existing history.

Args:

    service: Application service that records the outcome.
    store: Store used to find the job and its real job identity.

Read the retained source evaluation and workflow audit by source ID.

Args:

    service: Injected application or job-view service.

Returns:
    Retained source evaluation and workflow audit response.

Raises:

Set the next follow-up time for a job.

Args:

    body: ISO datetime of the next follow-up.
    service: Shared workflow service from the app state.

Returns:
    Acknowledgement.

get.description:
List a job's interview rounds, ascending by round index.

Args:
    job_id: Store-assigned job identity.
    service: Shared workflow service from the app state.

Returns:
    Interview rounds of the job.

post.description:
Add an interview round (auto-transitions applied -> interviewing).

patch.description:
Complete the indexed interview round, attaching optional notes.

Args:

    round_index: Round index to complete.
    body: Optional notes.

post.description:
Store manually pasted JD text and report the assessed quality.

Resolves the job's platform + canonical_id, delegates to the store's

Args:

    body: Pasted JD text (non-blank).
    store: Shared job store from the app state.

Returns:
    Job id and its stored assessed JD quality.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 when the job is unknown.

Append a note to a job (resets its ghost clock).

Args:
    job_id: Store-assigned job identity.
    body: Note text (non-blank).
    service: Shared workflow service from the app state.

Returns:
    Acknowledgement.

Raises:
    ApiError: 404 when the job has no status row.

Restore a ghosted/archived job to its last non-terminal status.

The restore target comes from the job's status history (domain

Args:
    job_id: Store-assigned job identity.
    service: Shared workflow service from the app state.
    store: Shared job store from the app state.

Returns:

Transition a single job, optionally appending a note.

Args:

    service: Shared workflow service from the app state.

Returns:

Raises:

Change an explicit annotation, preserving every application queue field.

Returns:
    The status after saving. Never the password.

Raises:

post.description:

Analyze the uploaded résumé with the selected Detailed model.

Args:

Raises:
    ApiError: If upload or provider setup is incomplete or analysis fails.

Generate or resume searches for the confirmed profile.

Args:
    service: Shared search-selection workflow.

    Profile-bound editable search suggestions.

Raises:

Persist edited, added, and deselected search rows.

get.description:
Evaluation funnel snapshots from pipeline runs.

Daily LLM latency percentiles and token averages.

    service: Shared performance service.

Returns:
    LLM daily stats response.

Aggregate performance metrics with period-over-period deltas.

    service: Shared performance service.

    Performance overview response.

Step timing series within the window, optionally filtered.

Args:
    service: Shared performance service.

Returns:
    Step timings response.

Explicitly enable only a threshold that passed future shadow checks.

Args:
    service: Shared personal learning policy service.
    editor: Effective local configuration editor.

    Saved configuration with the validated filter enabled.

    ApiError: If shadow validation has not made the model ready.

get.description:
Return current teacher-label, ranking, and shadow progress.

Return the Triage page with canonical priority projections.

    context: Application settings and store context.

Returns:

List canonical submission events, including their source provenance.

post.description:

Args:

get.description:
Return all currently matching canonical IDs for bulk selection.

Args:
    params: Validated Triage query filters and page window.
    store: Canonical store resolved from the request context.
    context: Application settings and store context.
    policy: Current scoring-policy snapshot for stale-score projection.

Schedule the next follow-up for one canonical job.

Args:

    body: Validated HTTP request body.

Returns:

    ApiError: The canonical parent is absent.

get.description:
List interview rounds for one canonical job.

    real_job_id: Canonical parent ID, never a source posting ID.
    store: Canonical store resolved from the request context.

    HTTP response containing canonical interview rounds.

Args:
    real_job_id: Canonical parent ID, never a source posting ID.
    body: Validated HTTP request body.
    store: Canonical store resolved from the request context.

Returns:

Raises:
    ApiError: The parent is absent or the round is invalid.

    store: Canonical store resolved from the request context.

Returns:
    The completed interview round.

    ApiError: No matching open round exists.

post.description:
Append a note to one canonical job.

Args:
    real_job_id: Canonical parent ID, never a source posting ID.
    body: Validated HTTP request body.
    store: Canonical store resolved from the request context.

Returns:
    Success response after the note is saved.

Raises:
    ApiError: The canonical parent is absent.

Restore one archived or ghosted canonical job.

Args:
    real_job_id: Canonical parent ID, never a source posting ID.

Returns:
    HTTP response with the canonical ID and restored status.

Raises:
    ApiError: The parent is absent or cannot be restored.

Update one canonical status and optionally append a note.

Args:
    real_job_id: Canonical parent ID, never a source posting ID.
    body: Validated HTTP request body.
    store: Canonical store resolved from the request context.

Returns:
